name: Capture one page to a file
info:
Click the button on the inject node to capture the page in its payload once. Nothing runs when the flow is deployed or Node-RED starts.

1. Open the **Site-Shot account** node and enter your API key. It is kept as a Node-RED credential and is never part of an exported flow.
2. In the inject node, replace `https://www.example.com/` with the public page you want to capture.
3. Deploy, then click the button on the inject node.

**Captures.** Get an API key at https://www.site-shot.com/start/; the free plan includes 100 captures a month, no card needed. Every click is one capture and counts toward the plan, including a capture that fails while the page is rendered.

**Files.** The screenshot is written to the `site-shot` folder in Node-RED's working directory: the `fileWorkingDirectory` setting, or else the directory Node-RED was started from. Every file gets a new name from the time and the message id, so no file is overwritten. The debug sidebar shows the file name.

**Failures.** A failed capture writes no file and is not retried. The catch node passes it to the debug sidebar, where `msg.error.code` says what went wrong; the site-shot node's help lists the codes.

**Schedule.** To capture the page regularly instead, set **Repeat** in the inject node. Each run is another capture.
